name: University of Lancashire
description:
Are you looking for a university that has been voted the University of the Year by Edufuturists Uprising for 2023?

The University of Central Lancashire offers a unique blend of highly appealing characteristics to the forward-thinking student. Not only is it famed for degrees in areas such as fashion and forensic science, but it also combines being highly affordable with providing recognised mental health and wellbeing support.

UCLan cares about its students. Voted the most affordable university in the UK in 2023, its location in Preston is close enough to Manchester but without the price tag.

Competitively priced tuition fees combine with small class sizes and personalised attention to create an environment conducive to the success of an international student.

Over 300 undergraduate degrees and approximately 200 postgraduate courses are available at the University of Central Lancashire.

About the University

The University of Central Lancashire is one of the top 20 biggest universities in the UK. Based in Preston, it dates back to the wonderfully-named Institution for the Diffusion of Useful Knowledge, founded in 1828. It grew to become the Harris Art College in the 20th Century before becoming a polytechnic and finally gaining university status in 1992. Almost 25,000 students come to UCLan every year and it has campuses in Burnley, Cumbria and Cyprus. 5,500 of those students are international students from more than 120 countries around the world. 

It ranks in the top 100 UK universities in the Complete University Guide and The Guardianâ€™s University Guide. According to the Center for World University Rankings, UCLan is in the top 7% of universities in the world.

The University of Central Lancashire has a 5-star rating for facilities according to UCLan.

Why the University of Central Lancashire?

  • The University of Central Lancashire has been named the top university in North England for producing start-up businesses and is ranked fifth overall in the UK (Tide, 2021).
  • Ranked 3rd in the UK for mental health support for students by the University Mental Health League Table, published in 2022 by HUMEN.
  • The university is ranked 5 QS stars for employability.

Join the thousands of students from around the world who experience first-hand the thriving student experience UCLan has to offer. Rankings from the Complete University Guide 2024 show UCLan achieving recognitions such as being 99th in the UK for teaching intensity and 72nd in the UK for student satisfaction.

Unlock your full potential. It starts here.

Browse courses easily today!

Student Life

The campus is filled with 38,000+ people from over 100 countries, making UCLan culturally diverse and inclusive. There are more than 70 societies to join, including the chess club, the environmental society, the French society, and various sports teams. The Student Union lounge provides spaces for socialising and opportunities to become a student ambassador to help others and improve their CV.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University of Lancashire is one of the UK’s largest universities and a popular choice for postgraduate students from around the world. With approximately 200 postgraduate programmes, the university offers advanced study options across Business, Engineering, Health Sciences, Media, Law, and creative disciplines.

The university offers dedicated support for postgraduate applicants, including guidance on course selection, entry requirements, English language criteria, and application timelines. Both UK and international students can apply for September and January intakes, depending on the course.

In addition to its strong postgraduate offerings, the University of Lancashire also provides a wide range of undergraduate, foundation, professional, and research (PhD) programmes across multiple disciplines.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: You’ll be part of a truly global community, with over 5500 international students from more than 120 countries. There are over 100 clubs and societies to join. Whether you’re into sports, music, gaming, or just want to meet new people, there’s something for you here. Plus, the Union also organises regular events, trips, and social nights throughout the year, including welcome fairs, live music and lots of amazing volunteering opportunities, which give you the chance to develop your skill and enhancing your CV with awards and recognition through Volunteering Award Scheme.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The university offers a wide range of accommodation options. Whether you want residence halls or private stays, there’s plenty to choose from. All halls come with the essentials you need. The University accommodation is guaranteed for full-time first year students who study on Preston Campus

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The library is open 24/7, where you can find study rooms, e-books and journals, access to PCs and laptops, plus volumes of books on different subject matters, especially valuable for master’s dissertations and research projects.

Sports
The sports facilities are comprehensive, with cardio training machines, rowing apparatus, indoor tennis courts, dance and fitness studios, spin bikes, squash courts and more. There is also an outdoor athletics track, football and rugby pitches, tennis courts and more.

Laboratory
At the university, you’ll find cutting-edge lab facilities, including the GBP 35M Engineering Innovation Centre (EIC) with 3D printing, robotics, flight simulators, and advanced manufacturing spaces. Plus, the JB Firth Building has forensic and chemistry sciences with six specialised labs. These facilities support PG taught courses and research-based degrees.

Cafeteria
You can access a range of food outlets at the campus, including Café 1828 in the Student Centre, Union Cafe, and the Foster Building Cafe, with various food options.
